info.name: Returns eligible appeals in the legacy process for a Veteran.

items.docs: Returns eligible legacy appeals for a Veteran. A legacy appeal is eligible if a statement of the case (SOC)  or supplemental statement of the case (SSOC) has been declared, and if the date of declaration is within the last 60 days.

params.name: icn
params.description: Veteran's Master Person Index (MPI) Integration Control Number (ICN). Optional when using a veteran-scoped token. Required when using a representative- or system-scoped token.
